measurement: Three independent fresh browsing contexts before/after; three same-tab refreshes after. Times are measured from document initialization until both desktop views have a decoded capture. These samples are not a network-latency guarantee.

handover.kind: Browser transport fixtures using retained native image pixels. Packet sequences and delays are test inputs, not neural activity.

reconnect.method: Only this observing tab withheld network data. The VM station continued throughout.
